senses.definition_en: tortilladora (tortilla press)

examples.english: Form discs with the corn dough in a tortilladora; stuff each one with the stewed alligator gar and seal them. Save a little stuffing for presentation.
examples.ref: 2009, “Caldo de empanadas de pejelagarto”, in Larousse los Top Chefs de México: con sus mejores recetas, México, D.F.: Ediciones Larousse, →ISBN, page 88:
examples.text: Forme discos con la masa de maíz en una tortilladora; rellene cada uno con el pejelagarto guisado y ciérrelos. Reserve un poco del relleno para la presentación.
examples.translation: Form discs with the corn dough in a tortilladora; stuff each one with the stewed alligator gar and seal them. Save a little stuffing for presentation.

examples.english: His tortilladora, hand-operated and small, is Vasco-Mexican due to its modifications. They've been doing it for years, producing 26 kilograms a week.
examples.ref: 2023 September 19, Irma Aguilar, “El auge de las tortillas mexicanas: el nuevo pan de los españoles”, in El País, Madrid: PRISA, →ISSN, →OCLC, archived from the original on 28 Aug 2025:
examples.text: Su tortilladora, manual y pequeña, es vasco-mexicana por las adaptaciones. Llevan años en ello, producen 26 kilos semanales.
examples.translation: His tortilladora, hand-operated and small, is Vasco-Mexican due to its modifications. They've been doing it for years, producing 26 kilograms a week.

examples.english: A grill, a platter of fresh meat and the tortilladora is all the gear the Caliph of León needs to operate fifteen hours a day (and win a Michelin star).
examples.ref: 2024 September 3, Laia Shamirian, “El Califa de León: los tacos sin pretensiones pero con estrella Michelin de Ciudad de México”, in Hule y Mantel, archived from the original on 28 Aug 2025:
examples.text: Una parrilla, una bandeja de carne fresca y la tortilladora es todo el engranaje que el Califa de León requiere para funcionar quince horas al día (y ganar una estrella Michelin).
examples.translation: A grill, a platter of fresh meat and the tortilladora is all the gear the Caliph of León needs to operate fifteen hours a day (and win a Michelin star).

examples.english: Trevilla Trejo added that they also brought three community kitchens to the state providing around 22,500 rations, as well as three water treatment plants, four tortilladoras and six communal dining halls with the capacity to provide hot food with 5,400 daily rations.
examples.ref: 2024 October 27, Gaspar Vela, “Más de 7 mil militares se trasladaron a Guerrero para atender emergencia por huracán 'John': Sedena”, in Milenio, archived from the original on 28 Aug 2025:
examples.text: Trevilla Trejo agregó que también se llevaron a la entidad tres cocinas comunitarias que proporcionan alrededor de 22 mil 500 raciones, así como tres plantas potabilizadoras, cuatro tortilladoras y seis comedores comunitarios con capacidad de proporcionar alimentación caliente con 5 mil 400 raciones diarias.
examples.translation: Trevilla Trejo added that they also brought three community kitchens to the state providing around 22,500 rations, as well as three water treatment plants, four tortilladoras and six communal dining halls with the capacity to provide hot food with 5,400 daily rations.

glosses: tortilladora (tortilla press)
